title: Despegar hotel ratings
description: One row per hotel with its guest rating, category scores and Despegar's own AI summary (charged), plus the up-to-four published comments and a status row per target (both free).

target.description: The input value (URL or hotel id) this row came from

hotel_id.description: Despegar's numeric hotel id (the number in /h-<id>/); the same id on every Despegar country domain

hotel_name.description: Hotel name as the chosen Despegar site writes it

hotel_url.description: Canonical hotel page URL on the domain that was read

city.description: City, from the location line under the hotel name (hotel rows)

country.description: Country of the hotel, in the page's language (hotel rows)

address.description: Street address as printed in the map section (hotel rows)

latitude.description: Latitude of the hotel marker (hotel rows)

longitude.description: Longitude of the hotel marker (hotel rows)

stars.description: Star rating, counted from the stars printed above the hotel name (hotel rows)

rating.description: Overall guest rating on Despegar's 0-10 scale, e.g. 8.4

rating_scale.description: The scale the rating is on: always 10 (hotel rows)

rating_5.description: The same score converted to the 0-5 star scale, e.g. 8.4 -> 4.2

rating_label.description: Despegar's word for the score, e.g. "Muy bueno" / "Very good" (hotel rows)

review_count.description: How many guest reviews the rating is based on, as Despegar counts them (e.g. 4511) — not how many this actor can deliver (hotel rows)

reviews_shown.description: How many individual comments the page actually publishes: at most four (hotel rows)

score_service.description: Category score 0-10: services and installations (hotel rows)

category_scores.description: The same six scores keyed by Despegar's own codes: service, servicePersonal, location, internetAccessAndQuality, cleaning, qualityprice (hotel rows)

summary.description: Despegar's own AI-written summary of what guests say about the hotel, generated by Despegar from all its reviews and published on the page — their text, not ours (hotel rows)

verified_note.description: Despegar's provenance note for the sample, e.g. "Clientes verificados por Grupo Despegar." (hotel rows)

providers.description: Which review providers the published comments come from; DESPEGAR on every hotel we have seen (hotel rows)

trip_types.description: Traveller profiles Despegar offers to filter the comments by: couple, friends, singles, family (hotel rows)

page_language.description: Language the domain served, e.g. es or en (hotel rows)

page_country.description: Country code of the Despegar site that was read, e.g. AR (hotel rows)

review_id.description: Despegar's id for the comment (review rows)

review_date.description: The month the guest wrote the comment, in the page's language, e.g. "Agosto 2023" — Despegar publishes no day (review rows)

review_month.description: The same date normalised to YYYY-MM (review rows)

text.description: The comment: the good half and the bad half joined; Despegar reviews have no title (review rows)

bad.description: What the guest disliked; absent when they only wrote praise (review rows)

reviewer.description: Guest's first name, when they published one (review rows)

reviewer_country_code.description: Two-letter code for that country (review rows)

trip_type.description: Who was travelling: couple | friends | singles | family (review rows)

trip_type_label.description: The same, as the page words it, e.g. "En familia" (review rows)

language.description: Language the comment was written in (review rows)

provider.description: Which provider supplied the comment, e.g. DESPEGAR (review rows)

provider_label.description: Despegar's badge for that provider, e.g. "Huésped verificado" (review rows)

helpful_votes.description: How many readers marked the comment useful (review rows)

status.description: ok | no_reviews | not_found | filtered | duplicate | blocked | limited | error (status rows)

hotels.description: 1 when a hotel row was delivered and charged for this target (status rows)

comments.description: How many published comments were delivered for this target, free (status rows)

filtered.description: 1 when minRating dropped this hotel before billing (status rows)

duplicates.description: 1 when this target is the same hotel as an earlier one (status rows)

error.description: Why a target produced nothing (status rows)
